title: Allogeneic cortical shells versus autologous shells from the patient perspective
studyType: Comparative clinical, maxgraft cortico n=20 vs autologous n=16, patient-reported outcomes
product: maxgraft cortico vs autologous bone shells
supports: Patient-experience evidence: higher morbidity and more side effects in the autologous group; would repeat the procedure 20/20 allogeneic vs 14/16 autologous. This is the safest ground for the "no second surgical site" argument because the endpoint is morbidity, not bone. Published data, cited in the botiss training decks and approved by botiss Medical Affairs.
